assumptions: Included only shipments with status = 'delivered' and non-null shipped and delivered dates
Computed whole days by truncating the julianday difference to an integer
sql:
SELECT
  MAX(CAST(julianday(delivered_date) - julianday(shipped_date) AS INTEGER)) AS max_lead_days,
  COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM shipments
WHERE status = 'delivered'
  AND shipped_date IS NOT NULL
  AND delivered_date IS NOT NULL;
